title: architecture_rules.v1
description: Validates schemas/architecture_rules.v1.json, the machine-readable form of 02_BackendZone/05_Application_Architecture.md. rig reads it for its deterministic static and trace checks; the Reviewer generates its architecture lens rubric from it. Both reject an invalid file instead of repairing it.

ownership_registry.description: Where the data-store owner map (store -> owning service) is read from.

review_sampling_ratio.description: Review-time test runs record every span; sampled traces can only show 'not observed'.

conventions.description: Span names and attributes the traced() wrapper must emit for trace checks to work. Each is a telemetry contract: renaming one updates these rules in the same change.

touches.description: The closed vocabulary rig uses in features.v1 structure.touches; a rule's applies_when draws from it.

stage.description: specified: written here only. implemented: rig runs it. golden_tested: it passes fixtures that must pass and fixtures designed to fail.

detects.description: The violation, stated as what rig matches.

requires.description: Span attributes or conventions the check needs. A span missing one is reported as unverifiable, never as compliant.

blocking.description: Whether a deterministic hit blocks the PR. Lens findings never block; they are advisory or escalate.

protected_class.description: A hit routes the change to required human approval at every autonomy level.

ask.description: The question the architecture lens answers for what the checks cannot decide. Rubric text is generated from this; it is never hand-written in the prompt.
